integration_tests.remote_type: Disposable local bare Git repositories only
coverage: Dry run changes neither remote refs nor source contents
New and changed files only; hash comparison detects same-size, same-mtime edits
Executable mode changes detected independently of content
Unrelated root and nested remote files preserved
Idempotent rerun creates no new commit
Stage-only leaves main unchanged; subsequent run publishes verified staged assets
Partial multi-batch interruption resumes without duplicate staged commits
Accepted staging and main pushes with lost acknowledgements are recognized
Concurrent main update rejects safely; rerun preserves other writer's work
Git filters, global configuration and .gitattributes do not transform raw bytes
Secrets, .runtime, .venv-native and local Git metadata excluded
Synthetic text token blocks upload without echoing secret content
Valid multipart model publishes and duplicate monolith is skipped
Missing, corrupted or oversized (>40 MiB) model parts reject before remote mutation
File/directory collisions reject rather than erase unrelated descendants

full_package_preflight.source: FRAME_AI_Studio v5 work package as present during validation
full_package_preflight.remote_type: Local bare Git fixture, not real GitHub
full_package_preflight.hash_checks: Each part plus reconstructed total SHA-256 and size; story/models/manifest.json consistency
full_package_preflight.note: Parent edits after this preflight may change file counts and size; uploader recalculates at execution.

public_repository_readonly_check.root_index: Git blob SHA matches recovered FRAME_CPU_Studio.html
public_repository_readonly_check.root_service_worker: No service-worker/sw.js path in public tree; matching root HTML contains no serviceWorker registration or caches.open marker

screenshot_inspection.finding: Local file URL opens newer Story Studio; GitHub repository has nested FRAME_AI_Studio plus independent root index; Pages root opens older CPU Photo Motion page.
screenshot_inspection.credential_handling: Exposed credential was not used, repeated or embedded in deliverables; guide instructs owner to revoke it.

compatibility.macos_windows: Compatibility designed and reviewed; not executed on physical macOS or Windows devices

guide_review: HTML structure and content reviewed. No browser visual render completed in this environment.
known_limits: Pages must publish main/root, or existing custom Actions must deploy only complete main updates; uploader does not alter publishing settings.
Uploader preserves remotely existing files even if absent locally; it never performs deletions.
Main changes during deployment cause safe stop and rerun; no force push or automatic rebase.
Text secret scanning is best-effort for common patterns; binary model integrity is checked by manifest hashes.
Conservative decimal 1 GB tree guard does not measure cumulative Git history or actual Pages compressed output.
Real SSH identity, repository branch rules and Pages deployment completion remain user-side checks.
